External save payloads are assumed to follow the existing FileIO JASS-tooltip data format; modified external scripts, injected runtime code and add-ons are outside this review. Cleanup must still preserve every noncandidate payload and MPQ locale/encryption/attributes/alias contract. Any input map or Lua byte change invalidates this contract and requires renewed dependency review unless the tool verifies a logically identical repack. Keep the editable original and build metadata for World Editor, rebuilding and object adoption; apply cleanup only to a separately saved distribution/test copy. Gameplay, save loading, model appearance, performance and multiplayer synchronization still require Warcraft III testing.
